# BibCit

> > BibCit provides automated citation generation and reference management tools for academic writing across multiple citation styles.

BibCit is a citation management platform that helps researchers and students automatically generate properly formatted citations and manage references. The site focuses on supporting major academic citation styles including APA, MLA, Chicago, and Harvard formats.

## Key Topics

- CiteGenie
- Citation Generator
- APA Style
- MLA Style
- Chicago Style
- Harvard Style
- Automatic Citations
- Reference Management
- Document Formatting
- Source Verification
- Academic Writing
- Citation Styles
- Free Tools

## Citation Tools

- [CiteGenie - Automatic Citation Generator with Verified References for Documents](https://www.bibcit.com/en/citegenie): Automatic citation generator supporting APA, MLA, Chicago, and Harvard styles with verified references for academic documents
